rudderstack_expected_payload.description: Confluent Cloud uses the shared Kafka producer package. The NewProducerForConfluentCloud constructor creates a SASL/PLAIN-over-TLS Kafka client authenticated with Confluent Cloud API key and secret credentials. Messages are produced using the standard Kafka wire protocol via the kafkaclient library.

connection.protocol: Kafka wire protocol over TLS with SASL/PLAIN authentication

authentication.api_key: Confluent Cloud API key (maps to SASL username)
authentication.api_secret: Confluent Cloud API secret (maps to SASL password)

tls.description: TLS is always enabled for Confluent Cloud connections

connection.ping_description: Connection is verified via Ping after client creation, within the dial timeout context

destination_config.topic: Required. The Confluent Cloud topic name to produce messages to.
destination_config.bootstrapServer: Required. Comma-separated list of Confluent Cloud bootstrap server addresses.
destination_config.apiKey: Required. Confluent Cloud API key for SASL/PLAIN authentication.
destination_config.apiSecret: Required. Confluent Cloud API secret for SASL/PLAIN authentication.

message_format.structure: Kafka message with topic, key, value, and timestamp
message_format.topic_resolution: Per-event topic field from JSON payload takes precedence; falls back to destination config topic
message_format.key: Derived from userId field in the event JSON payload (via gjson path 'userId')
message_format.value: JSON-serialized message field from the event payload (via gjson path 'message')
message_format.timestamp: Set to current server time at produce invocation (time.Now())
message_format.encoding: JSON (no Avro support in Confluent Cloud config; Avro serialization is only available for standard Kafka destinations)

flow: 1. Validate producer is not nil (returns 400 if invalid)
2. Unmarshal destConfig to extract topic for fallback
4. Create timeout context from configured or default timeout (10 seconds)
5. Delegate to sendMessage which parses JSON, extracts message/userId/topic fields
6. Prepare Kafka message with prepareMessage(topic, key, value, timestamp)
7. Publish message via underlying Kafka producer

error_handling.nil_producer: Returns HTTP 400 with 'Could not create producer'
error_handling.invalid_config: Returns HTTP 500 for retry on bad configuration
error_handling.missing_topic: Returns HTTP 500 with 'invalid destination configuration: no topic'
error_handling.invalid_message: Returns HTTP 400 with 'Invalid message' if message field is nil
error_handling.publish_failure: Returns HTTP 500 with publish error details for retry

timeout.configurable: via common.Opts.Timeout passed from Router destination config

field_mappings.note: No direct Segment equivalent. Segment covers Confluent via generic Kafka. Uses shared Kafka producer.
field_mappings.producer_routing: CONFLUENT_CLOUD destination name routes through streammanager.NewProducer switch to kafka.NewProducerForConfluentCloud
field_mappings.shared_kafka_package: Confluent Cloud reuses the services/streammanager/kafka/ package with a Confluent-specific constructor; the underlying Produce/sendMessage/prepareMessage code path is identical to standard Kafka
field_mappings.authentication_difference: Standard Kafka supports flexible TLS/SASL configuration; Confluent Cloud always uses SASL/PLAIN over TLS with API key/secret credentials via client.NewConfluentCloud
field_mappings.config_difference: Standard Kafka uses hostname/port/SSL/SASL fields; Confluent Cloud uses bootstrapServer/apiKey/apiSecret — a simplified config surface
field_mappings.avro_support: Confluent Cloud config does not include Avro serialization fields; messages are always JSON. Standard Kafka supports optional Avro serialization with schema registry
field_mappings.topic_resolution: Per-event topic field in JSON payload takes precedence over the default topic from destination config
field_mappings.partition_key: Derived from the userId field in the event JSON; serves as the Kafka message key for partition assignment
field_mappings.message_value: The message field from the input JSON is extracted and re-serialized as the Kafka message value
field_mappings.timestamp_handling: Kafka message timestamp is set to server time at produce invocation, not the event's original timestamp
field_mappings.envelope_fields: RudderStack events include rudderId, originalTimestamp, sentAt, receivedAt — these are part of the message value passed through to Confluent Cloud

notes: Confluent Cloud is a RudderStack-unique stream destination. There is no direct Segment Confluent Cloud destination; Segment covers Confluent Cloud via the generic Kafka destination (slug: actions-kafka). RudderStack implements Confluent Cloud as a dedicated destination type (CONFLUENT_CLOUD) with a specialized constructor (NewProducerForConfluentCloud) that uses SASL/PLAIN over TLS authentication with Confluent Cloud API key/secret credentials, but shares all message production logic with the standard Kafka producer. The Confluent Cloud producer is registered in the stream manager factory (services/streammanager/streammanager.go) and listed in the Custom Destination Manager's ObjectStreamDestinations array (router/customdestinationmanager/customdestinationmanager.go). Configuration requires: topic, bootstrapServer, apiKey, and apiSecret. The connection is validated via Ping on creation. Metrics are tracked under the router.kafka.creation_time_confluent_cloud timer. Since there is no direct Segment equivalent, payload parity comparison is not applicable — the fixture documents RudderStack's Confluent Cloud payload format for regression testing.
